content.text: {"core": "Alignment brings scattered parts into one working order, so effort pulls in a single direction. In Drive, it sets that order behind forward motion — the whole self aimed at what it is moving toward. Overdone, everything must agree before the wheels turn, and no part is allowed to pull differently. The push waits on perfect agreement, and the agreeing never finishes.", "sheetLine": "Nothing moves until every part agrees; the lining-up never lets the going begin."}
